content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NFDC Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 10-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NFDC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NFDC Sr. Executive posts?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the NFDC Sr. Executive posts is 10 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Sr. Executive post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline from a recognized University. Desirable qualifications include Film/Media/Mass Communication/Event Management/Public Relations/Marketing/Hospitality Management.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Sr. Executive recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Sr. Executive posts is up to 45 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Sr. Executive position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated pay of Rs. 70,000/- per month all inclusive.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NFDC Sr. Executive recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the NFDC LinkedIn Portal on or before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this NFDC recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is contract-based.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is ADV/064/Contractual/03.08.2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the minimum experience required for the Sr. Executive posts?
faq.answer: A minimum of 5 years' experience is required in relevant fields such as film festivals, media events, or celebrity management.

faq.question: Q10. In which city will the Sr. Executive be posted?
faq.answer: The Sr. Executive posts are for 57th IFFI 2026 in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
